data_standard.complete_definition: The capture's first observation is at or before the regular session open, its last observation is at or after the last regular close minus one minute, and every band is covered. A trading day with no stored capture is missing, never a holiday and never padded.
requirements: raw capture preservation and SHA-256 hashes
at least 60 complete sessions before a preliminary comparison
preferably 100 or more complete sessions across market regimes
data_standard.monitor_scope: research only; no live signal, target, stop, notification or broker change
